title: Lifetime Matrix & Contributor Checklist for UI Primitives (tokens, buttons, tables, charts)
creator: Luis Ortega
description: Create a concise, operational playbook that defines the lifecycle ("lifetime matrix") for design primitives and a contributor-ready checklist for anyone proposing changes to tokens, buttons, tables, or charts. The playbook must bridge design and engineering signoff expectations, document required artifacts for RFCs, enumerate automated checks (lint/codemod/storybook), and prescribe a pragmatic deprecation workflow with timelines and migration support. Goal: reduce ad-hoc component changes, speed reviews, and ensure safe deprecation with clear communications and tooling.
deliverables: Lifetime Matrix diagram (Experimental / Stable / Supported / Deprecated / Removed)
Contributor checklist template for PRs and RFCs
Design+Engineering review checklist (accessibility, tokens, performance, test coverage)
Deprecation policy with example timelines and canned user-facing communications
Minimal codemod plan and lint rules for token renames
Example RFC template and triage rubric
acceptance_criteria: Lifetime Matrix published in Confluence and linked from the design system homepage
Contributor checklist added to CONTRIBUTING.md and surfaced in the design repo PR template
At least one pilot deprecation (button variant) executed end-to-end using new checklist and codemod
Cross-functional approval from Eng/PM/Security/Analytics recorded in comments
Automated lint entry and Storybook smoke test added to CI for one component family
review_checklist: Design: Figma token usage, responsive states, visual QA frames
Engineering: accessibility (axe/keyboard focus), aria roles, unit & visual tests
Performance: render cost and bundle size delta estimate
Migration: token mapping table and codemod feasibility note
Docs: updated usage examples, migration guide, semantic rationale
Security/Privacy: no PII in examples, no external-only assets referenced
Rollout plan: canary percentage, fallback variants, monitoring signals
rfc_process: 1) Create short RFC in repo: problem, alternatives, migration plan, measurable risk
2) Tag owners: design-owner, eng-owner, pm-owner, and set reviewers (min 2)
3) Attach design frames + token diff + Storybook examples
4) Run cross-team review for 5 business days (shorter for P0 hotfixes)
5) Record final decision and link to follow-up issues (implementation + docs + codemod)
deprecation_policy_summary: Phase 1: Deprecation announced (T0) — docs updated, migration guide published, owners notified
Phase 2: Supported but deprecated (T0 + 90 days) — lint warnings introduced; consumers can migrate
Phase 3: Breaking deprecation (T0 + 180 days) — runtime removal gated with feature flag or opt-in
Phase 4: Removal (T0 + 365 days) — component removed from lib; codemod available to migrate callers
Exceptions: critical security fixes or legal requirements may accelerate timelines with PM approval
